# Endless Summoning

Notes:
- To START Endless Summoning you must reach cyan on the nodes and unlock the endless summoning node
- Then Click the infinite icon in the top right of your summoners table, then find opponent.
- This expects you to know and have an understanding on summoning
- This will only cover the new content within summoning and it's core changes
-  ⚠️

Index:  ⚠️ add quick links
- Whats New
- Table Reward List
- Actual rewards
-

## ** UNLOCK + What's NEW?**
- 12 new rewards on the Summoner's Table https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1306667055646244937/1306667090773672037
- You can hold down to spawn/spam summoning units. (No more spam clicking)
- A New Summoning creature "Guardio", they sit in midfield, do 0 dmg and have 12x HP and arn't knocked back. 0/30 each upgrade levels HP.
- Summoning Cards, modifiers on a battle that change the fight a lot.

## Strategies
- Pretty much same as regular summoning, remember to let your hp drop once you start to struggle for massive ATK buff. 
- Stage 46-50  SEE VIDEOS: https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1306667055646244937/1306751236552527882
- Seems people get a little wall at 52/~ and have difficulties getting through it, but once you do you get a bunch further.

## Summoning Cards
- Preset effects on a fight.
- These are preset to the same fights for everyone
- See each battle, cards and rewards further down: https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1306667055646244937/1306667098189201508

https://i.imgur.com/0ZBPlu7.png

## **Summoner's Table Rewards:**
- There are 12 new rewards on the Summoner's Table
- 4 of them are for World 7 and currently do nothing.

These rewards include:
- +x Stamp Level per day
- +x% Villager Exp
- +% Ballot Bonus
- +% Class Exp
- x Equinox Max Level
- +% Monument AFK
- x Meal Bonuses
- +% World 7 A
- +% World 7 B
- +% World 7 C
- +% World 7 D
- x Winner Bonuses

**+ Equinox Max Level:**
The +1 Equinox affects the following:
- Matching Scim
- Slow Roast Wiz
- Metal Detector
- Faux Jewels
- Food Lust
- Equinox Symbols
- Voter Rights

Simplified:
The +x Levels to equinox will give benefits to TD runs, Gaming nuggets, Drop Rate, Meal cost recution, EXTRA TALENT LEVELS, Voter ballots.

## **Win and Rewards:**
- List of Atk/Hp, Reward and Fight Card per battle.
- These seem to repeat after 40. 41 is the same as 1, 42 is the same as 2.
